candidate: Independent process scheduler plus private renderer reuse, retirement collection and classic frame scheduling

profiles.default: Unmodified pinned headless launch policy, plus existing private native composition on candidate
profiles.software-video: Append --disable-accelerated-video-decode to each engine; software video playback remains available

policy.order: Default Playwright, default candidate, changed Playwright, changed candidate; reverse in block 1
policy.clock: Complete original supervised owner command including HTTP service startup, execution, shutdown and observed natural process drain

instrumentedStartup.scope: Separate GPU/startup trace and isolated-world rAF wrapper instrumentation; each capture includes deliberate 3.2-second pre-close wait. No timing ratio or achievable saving inferred from these instrumented complete durations.

retainedFailures: Initial graphics-control setup used custom renderer reservation against stock Chromium; its first context closure failed on an unavailable private protocol method. Corrected before comparisons.

Video controls pass selected API, pixel, trusted-input and isolation assertions but fail the independently enforced idle CPU bound when renderer reservation is enabled. Their inner functional status is not whole-campaign success.
Turning off only custom early-idle deadlines, then additionally frame uncapping, did not remove the high CPU behavior.

Disabling renderer reservation and its diagnostic probe while keeping candidate-fast flags and software decoding passes the same three-context controls and idle bound. The exact native causal loop is not yet proved.
decision: Software decoder initialization materially improves these complete candidate runs, but matched Playwright also benefits. No cell reaches 2x in both blocks. Do not promote either private profile: renderer-retirement media cleanup remains a correctness/resource blocker. The default public launch policy is unchanged.
limitations: Two applications and two opposite-order blocks only, not the final nine-scenario eight-pair campaign.
Selected graphics/video checks do not prove all codecs, WebCodecs, accelerated decoding, browser graphics, or scheduler behavior.
One Linux machine; GPU initialization costs depend on hardware and installed drivers.
CPU idle observations are charged cgroup windows, not final resource admission. Root wait CPU and sampled RSS in application runs retain their original separate meanings.
No public capability-contract or package release is established. Prior renderer reuse evidence must be read with the newly discovered media boundary.
